page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek words αἱματεκχυσία and ἐκχυωμένῳ (the line-end hyphen and the final letters, shown as "μεν@" with an ω-like sign at the line end) are marked [?]. "2.s." in the Isaiah reference ("Jef. XI, 2.s.") is read as a fifth-verse marker and marked by its form, not as a number; it may be a printed "5". Long s was rendered as plain s in "Jes." and similar words. Printed text continues on the next page after "supradictæ". The blue "9" at the top right is handwriting and not a page number.
